scripts.test:tz-utc: node -e "import('child_process').then(cp => process.exit(cp.spawnSync('vitest', ['run', ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, TZ: 'UTC' } }).status ?? 1))"
scripts.test:tz-karachi: node -e "import('child_process').then(cp => process.exit(cp.spawnSync('vitest', ['run', ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, TZ: 'Asia/Karachi' } }).status ?? 1))"
